verdict.rationale: Mailgun's own docs describe Domain Sending Keys, which are API keys restricted to sending messages on the /messages and /messages.mime endpoints for a single domain. That is a real first-party least-privilege credential an agent could use, but it covers only one narrow scope. missing for 10: configurable permission scopes beyond send-only (e.g., read-only analytics, domain management), role-based or custom-scoped API keys, agent- or MCP-specific credential guidance, key expiry/rotation documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Domain Sending Keys are API keys that only allow sending messages via a POST call on /messages and /messages.mime endpoints for the domain in which they are created for.
